source_snapshot.note: Pinned commit/path body independently hashed as Git blob; computed OID matches provider tree OID. Non-empty source was read; no source-image bytes used.

related.reason_vi: Mảng thiết kế hệ thống dùng khung bảy bước của bài trước.

claims.evidence: Only the Tech Interview Handbook and System Design Primer READMEs were read (local clones); every other resource named in the lesson comes from the source and was not checked.

mobile.evidence: Chromium (Playwright) rendered the full lesson at each width with optional sections open; diagram scale measured from the rendered image and every SVG text box checked against the viewBox. Not learner testing and not GitHub or a real phone.

claims.claim_vi: Tech Interview Handbook is a repository of interview preparation material that includes behavioral questions.
claims.verified_by: README read from a local clone.

claims.claim_vi: System Design Primer is a repository for studying system design.
claims.verified_by: README read from a local clone.

claims.claim_vi: The resources LeetCode, Cracking the Coding Interview, NeetCode, System Design Interview books, Grokking, Designing Data-Intensive Applications, A Life Engineered, Interviewready, Educative OOD, Head First Design Patterns, interviewing.io, Pramp, Meetapro, LinkedIn, Monster and Indeed exist and fit the six areas.
claims.verified_by: Carried from the source as general description; not independently checked. Not checked for availability, price or quality.

design_notes_vi: Hình theo sáu mảng chứ không theo tên sản phẩm; thẻ đỏ nói danh sách tài nguyên chưa kiểm. Các gợi ý cách luyện là ý kiến chung của người biên soạn. Không dùng ảnh nguồn.
source_deviations: Source is a bare list of products; the lesson organizes it by area with a practice suggestion for each and flags that the list was not checked and may serve interests related to some of its entries.
STAR is named in the source without explanation; the lesson spells out the acronym as general knowledge.
editorial_note_vi: Bài mới viết trong kho này, chờ review kỹ thuật. Chưa user testing hoặc phê duyệt phát hành.
